## Photo Mode, gesture wheel, and saved loadouts

The biggest feature drop since the redesign — a cinematic camera, a faster wheel, and switchable loadouts.

### 📸 Photo Mode

A cinematic camera opened from a button in the menu header. **Drag to orbit** around your character, **scroll to zoom**, pick a **look filter** (cinematic, noir, warm, vibrant, cool), toggle **depth-of-field** and a **rule-of-thirds grid**, then capture — the MBT watermark rides on every shot.

Server owners can optionally wire a **Discord webhook** so players send shots straight to a channel with one click. The webhook URL stays server-side, and captures are size-capped and throttled per player. Uses `screenshot-basic` when present, falls back to "hide HUD + your own screenshot key" otherwise. Fully tunable via `MBT.PhotoMode`.

### 🕹️ Gesture Wheel

The Emote Wheel gets a **radial mode**: hold the wheel key and **flick the mouse toward a slot**, weapon-wheel style, instead of scrolling through slots one by one. Far faster once it's in muscle memory. Scroll still works as a fallback. Switch back to the classic linear mode any time via `MBT.EmoteWheel.Mode`.

### 🎭 Personas / Loadouts

Save named loadouts (e.g. **Cop**, **Party**) that bundle your **Quick Binds** (NUM1-6) and **Wheel slots**, and switch between them in one click — your NUM keys and wheel swap instantly. The active loadout auto-saves as you edit it; creating a new one clones your current setup so nothing is ever lost. A non-deletable **Default** is always there as a safe fallback. Up to 4 loadouts (configurable).

### 🔎 Smarter search

Search now matches an emote's **prop and animation** too, not just its name — so typing "radio" finds the walkie-talkie emotes, "beer" finds the drinking emotes, and so on.

### Install

Download `mbt_emote_menu.zip` below and drop it in your resources folder. Existing installs upgrade in place — favourites, recent list, wheel slots, custom lists and your binds are all kept (your current setup becomes the "Default" loadout automatically).

Photo Mode's "Send to Discord" is optional and uses [screenshot-basic](https://github.com/citizenfx/screenshot-basic); without it, Photo Mode still works with your own screenshot key.

Requires [rpemotes-reborn](https://github.com/alberttheprince/rpemotes-reborn) latest.
